If everything looks good on Zhejiang I would love to see specs finalized, client releases made, and targets for sepolia and goerli in relatively short order. Sepolia can check client releases, and Goerli will be a good test for scale and messiness. Is lodestar-geth working? Seems stuck on the monitoring page <@412614104222531604> is resyncing it synced Yep, that's the plan: we plan to discuss sepolia timelines on this week's ACDC call 🙂 why the strange # attestations per block distribution? nimbus seems to be unable to produce blocks I have submitted 2k BLS changes nimbus-erigon-1 has failed and nimbus-besu-1 has failed within the same epoch https://zhejiang.beaconcha.in/slot/43756 https://zhejiang.beaconcha.in/slot/43764 https://zhejiang.beaconcha.in/slot/43750 you are searching for nimbus graffiti, but a block that is not proposed will not have a graffiti can look, devops@zhejiang-something.ethpandaops.io? `zhejiang-testnet-nimbus-erigon-1` Also looks like nimbus wasn't able to take in any bls gossip I have submitted 2k from lodestar/geth all other clients were able to receive the gossip, but nimbus wasn't it's running https://github.com/status-im/nimbus-eth2/commit/94837caa2a5fba5ab2777dbd9ff7f0a422cbd4b2 which is before https://github.com/status-im/nimbus-eth2/pull/4580 which should have fixed that the mechanism by which it was unable to produce a block ah ok I'll update nimbus gossip or REST? as far as this, it's hard to say without debug-level logs Want me to enable debug? Image is almost done yeah e.g., we have `"BLS to execution change received"`, etc which would show exactly that or if it's ignoring/rejecting, on what basis restarted nimbus okay, will monitor it looks like at least one node (haven't checked all) is receiving them and not showing any particular error: ``` DBG 2023-02-07 17:34:36.002+00:00 BLS to execution change received topics="gossip_eth2" blsToExecutionChange="(bls_to_execution_change: (validator_index: 61494, from_bls_pubkey: \"b57d80f2\", to_execution_address: \"(data: [49, 115, 95, 6, 197, 109, 36, 68, 87, 114, 197, 50, 69, 173, 119, 37, 50, 193, 50, 173])\"), signature: \"b387a2c8\")" DBG 2023-02-07 17:34:36.034+00:00 BLS to execution change received topics="gossip_eth2" blsToExecutionChange="(bls_to_execution_change: (validator_index: 61495, from_bls_pubkey: \"a4425229\", to_execution_address: \"(data: [49, 115, 95, 6, 197, 109, 36, 68, 87, 114, 197, 50, 69, 173, 119, 37, 50, 193, 50, 173])\"), signature: \"af5de93f\")" ``` that's nimbus-geth-1 ok sounds good probably I was running an older unstable version then looks like nimbus is now proposing blocks again so all good
